audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Rumble wins Levels 2, 3, First item while the prose (whys, early/mid, spikes) says those levels are Urgot's.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Urgot for rows 0-5 and Rumble only at 2+ items, and the 52.81% win rate over 409 games supports an Urgot-favoured lane that flips late.
audit.corrected: Urgot owns Level 1 through First item; Rumble takes over at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text gave no cooldown anchor for The Equalizer.
audit.why: Riot kit: R is 130/105/80s. That is the longest cooldown in the matchup and defines the window after he uses it.
audit.corrected: The Equalizer is 130s at rank 1; Scrap Shield is a flat 6s at every rank, so it is the shield, not the ult, you must bait every trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Scrap Shield and The Equalizer with no numbers; phases[1] gave no Disdain cooldown.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and shields on the charge, so it is both engage and effective health; Scrap Shield's 6s means it is up nearly every trade and cannot be waited out, only baited.
audit.corrected: Bait Scrap Shield inside its 6s window rather than waiting it out; land Disdain (16s at rank 1) into W spray for the level-2 kill.

edits.before: E or W second depending on kill pressure. A landed E-flip into W spray already wins most level-2 exchanges outright.
edits.after: E or W second by kill pressure. Disdain is 16s at rank 1, so land the flip into W spray and the level-2 trade is over.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Rumble The Equalizer: A long line of fire that zones and chunks — his teamfight tool. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Scrap Shield: 6s flat, so it is back nearly every trade — bait it, then commit inside that window. - The Equalizer: 130s at rank 1. Once he lays it, walk him down; it is his only zoning tool.

edits.before: Rumble wastes Scrap Shield — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His damage is all magic — Mercury's Treads early, then Force of Nature.

edits.before: Your R (Fear Beyond Death) beats his all-in even through The Equalizer. If he ults, Purge him and R to execute before his zone matters, since he is squishy.
edits.after: Your R (Fear Beyond Death) beats his all-in through The Equalizer — a 130s ult at rank 1. If he lays it, Purge him and execute before the flames matter.

notes: missingInteractions claims Rumble denies 'Corrosive Charge (Q)' as a dash — the kit flag misfires: Riot's Q text is a ground-targeted explosive charge, no dash. Disdain (E) is the mobility Scrap Shield's speed and The Equalizer's terrain actually contest. Left that out of the page rather than assert it.
